name: BW Animated Sprites
description: Replaces the Gen 3 battle pictures and Pokedex entries with the animated Black/White sprites from your own imported dump. Every view plays at the art's native size: nothing is scaled down or resampled, so wide fronts and tall backs stay sharp, and each picture stands on the cartridge's ground row. The Pokedex plays the idle animation at native size, centred in the card's picture area. Distinct female graphics are used front and back; normal and shiny palettes included. The OPTION menu gains MY POKEMON and OPPONENT switches (BW or DEFAULT), and the choice is saved. Ships no game art: import Black/White with the launcher's gen5_bw importer first.
